facts.fact: BCX operates two R260m data centres in Midrand (3000 sq m between them, about two-thirds utilised) providing multi-tenanted private cloud, computing and storage services to large organisations, and also runs two data centres at Sanlam's Bellville head office.

BCX states its two operating Midrand data centres were developed to tier-4 specifications as rated by the Uptime Institute; this is a design specification stated by the operator, with no certification mentioned.
